title: Earth as a System
summary: Grade 9: Earth’s five spheres, the Sun’s energy and the greenhouse effect, winds and ocean currents, and the cycles of carbon, nitrogen, water and oxygen.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Energy from the Sun and the cycling of matter link air, water, ice, rock and life into one Earth system that human activity can unbalance.

factual: How does nitrogen get into living things?
conceptual: Why does a change in one sphere affect the others?
How does the greenhouse effect keep Earth habitable?
debatable: Should rich countries cut emissions faster than developing countries?

cbseChapters: Class 9 Exploration (2026): Earth as a System: Energy, Matter and Life
